# Andrei Repo

> Senior QA Engineer specialising in test automation for SaaS and regulated
> iGaming. Based in Spain, working remotely across EU/UK/US time zones.
> Open to senior and lead QA Engineering roles.

## Contact

- Email: contact@andreirepo.com
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/andreirepo
- GitHub: https://github.com/andreirepo
- Resume (PDF): https://andreirepo.com/assets/AndreiRepoResume.pdf

## Current position

QA Automation Engineer at Open Assessment Technologies (2026 — present).
Maintains Cypress suites across legacy and modern codebases, runs GitHub
Actions CI/CD with test parallelisation, and owns regression and release risk.

Previously: QA Engineer at Lottomart (2025 — 2026), QA Engineer at Sketch
(2021 — 2025), where he led the migration from Cypress to Playwright.

## What he does

Builds test automation that lets teams release every day: Playwright and
WebdriverIO suites, CI gates that block regressions, and AI-assisted workflows
for writing and maintaining tests. Reported result: 60% faster release cycles
with zero critical post-release defects.

Certifications: ISTQB, AWS Certified.

Tools: Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, TypeScript, Python, GitHub Actions,
Docker, AWS, Terraform.

## Site

- [Home](https://andreirepo.com/en/): profile, projects, experience, contact.
  Also available in Spanish at https://andreirepo.com/es/
- [Blog](https://andreirepo.com/en/blog/): six technical write-ups on test
  automation, self-hosted CI/CD, AWS, and accessibility testing.

### Articles

- [Building an AI Agent Layer for E2E Test Automation](https://andreirepo.com/en/blog/ai-agentic-setup-e2e-test-automation/):
  encoding team test patterns into machine-readable files so any developer can
  generate and maintain E2E tests.
- [Fixing 40+ WCAG Contrast Violations with axe-core and Property-Based Testing](https://andreirepo.com/en/blog/fixing-wcag-contrast-with-axe-core-and-property-based-testing/):
  finding, verifying and permanently preventing colour contrast regressions in CI.
- [Self-Hosting Without Opening Ports: Cloudflare Tunnel + Traefik](https://andreirepo.com/en/blog/self-hosted-cloudflare-tunnel-traefik/):
  exposing self-hosted services with no inbound ports.
- [Self-Hosted CI/CD with GitHub Actions over SSH and Cloudflare Tunnel](https://andreirepo.com/en/blog/self-hosted-cicd-github-actions-ssh-cloudflare/)
- [Local AI Code Review in GitHub Actions with LM Studio](https://andreirepo.com/en/blog/local-ai-code-review-github-actions-lm-studio/)
- [Email Forwarding with AWS SES, S3 and Lambda](https://andreirepo.com/en/blog/email-forwarding-aws-ses-s3-lambda/)

## Notes

- The site is a static Astro build; all content above is present in the HTML
  and does not require JavaScript.
- Spanish translations of every article exist under /es/blog/.
- Structured data: schema.org Person, WebSite, ProfilePage and BlogPosting.
